data.description:
## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-3: calibration-report.sh monthly --fixture=tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs returns exit 0 with a bugs-by-channel section containing at least one entry

Create tests/scripts/test-calibration-attribution-e2e.sh — a conditional E2E test runnable today even though calibration-report.sh has not been implemented yet (story cc87 not executed). Structure:

  1. Always-on assertion: tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs/sample-bugs.json exists and parses as a non-empty JSON array (via jq)
  2. Conditional cc87 assertion: if plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh exists AND is executable, invoke calibration-report.sh monthly --fixture=tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs and assert exit 0 + stdout contains a 'bugs-by-channel' section with at least one entry. If script is absent, emit a SKIP line citing 'cc87 not yet executed' and exit 0 — the test re-tightens automatically once cc87 lands.
  3. Failure modes: missing fixture exits non-zero; report exits non-zero exits non-zero; empty bugs-by-channel exits non-zero.

## Testing Mode
RED — test currently SKIPs the calibration-report.sh section (cc87 not executed). The always-on fixture assertion is the active RED check. Once cc87 lands, re-running this test will activate the full assertion automatically.

## Acceptance Criteria
- E2E test exists and is executable — Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-calibration-attribution-e2e.sh
- E2E test exits 0 today (fixture present, calibration-report.sh absent → SKIP path) — Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-calibration-attribution-e2e.sh
- SKIP path explicitly cites cc87 — Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-calibration-attribution-e2e.sh 2>&1 | grep -qE 'SKIP.*cc87|cc87.*not.*executed' || test -x plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh
- Failure mode: missing fixture causes non-zero exit — Verify: grep -Eq 'test -f tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs/sample-bugs.json|jq.*sample-bugs.json' tests/scripts/test-calibration-attribution-e2e.sh && grep -Eq 'exit 1|return 1|FAIL' tests/scripts/test-calibration-attribution-e2e.sh
- Test invokes calibration-report.sh with the documented CLI shape — Verify: grep -q 'calibration-report.sh monthly --fixture=tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs' tests/scripts/test-calibration-attribution-e2e.sh
- Test asserts bugs-by-channel section in output — Verify: grep -q 'bugs-by-channel' tests/scripts/test-calibration-attribution-e2e.sh
- ShellCheck passes — Verify: shellcheck tests/scripts/test-calibration-attribution-e2e.sh

## File Impact
- tests/scripts/test-calibration-attribution-e2e.sh — Create
data.title: Create conditional E2E test for calibration-report.sh --fixture attribution
